info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Create Payments Payments Authorize-v4-spec
info.description: The Payment Authorization API enables businesses to securely authorize payment transactions. This endpoint facilitates the processing of payment requests from customers, ensuring that funds can be verified and cleared for various payment methods. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and financial applications that require real-time payment processing capabilities. By utilizing this service, merchants can enhance their transaction workflows and improve the overall purchase experience for their users.

post.description: Initiates the process of authorizing a payment. This operation verifies the payment details and ensures that sufficient funds are available before proceeding with the transaction.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to authorize a payment. Ensure that all required fields are populated correctly to process the authorization successfully.

200.description: The request was successful, and the payment has been authorized.
